unit.why: A biographical section on R. Levi Yitzhak of Berdichev. It contains a full anecdote: the Pinsk community withholds the rebbetzin's weekly money, the Maggid's disciples punish Pinsk, and the Maggid rebukes them and makes a prediction. It ends with dates and a list of his sons.
unit.boundary_note: Continues the biography begun in the previous division (section א). The closing words 'ממדריגותיו הנוראים' are a heading for the next division (ג).

stories.start_quote: הי׳ גאון גדול עד להפליא וכפי הנשמע
stories.summary_en: R. Levi Yitzhak, rabbi of Pinsk, is persecuted for travelling to the Maggid of Mezritch. When the community stops his wife's weekly money, she tells the Maggid's disciples, who bring ruin on Pinsk. The Maggid rebukes them, saying this cost them their 'head' (his own death), yet predicts that hasidim will prevail over their persecutors until the messiah. Levi Yitzhak later serves in Zhelikhov and then Berdichev until his death.
